mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT kd.id, kd.document_name, kd.user_id, kd.knowledge_base_id, kd.file_type, kd.file_size, kd.storage_path, kd.embedding_model_id, kd.status, kd.chunk_count, kd.error_message, kd.security_label_id, kd.create_time, kd.update_time, kd.del_flag FROM knowledge_document kd LEFT JOIN knowledge_security_label ksl ON kd.security_label_id = ksl.id WHERE kd.del_flag = 0 AND kd.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND (ksl.label_level IS NULL OR ksl.label_level <= ( SELECT MAX(ksl2.label_level) FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.id JOIN knowledge_security_label ksl2 ON sr.security_label_id = ksl2.id WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} )) ORDER BY kd.create_time DESC
